query:
SELECT 
  state_code, district, rating,
  candidate1_name as dem_candidate, candidate1_party,
  candidate2_name as rep_candidate, candidate2_party,
  is_open
FROM house_races
WHERE status = 'General'
  AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL 
  AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL
  AND candidate1_name != '' 
  AND candidate2_name != ''
ORDER BY 
  CASE rating 
    WHEN 'Toss-up' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'Lean D' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'Lean R' THEN 3 
    WHEN 'Likely D' THEN 4 
    WHEN 'Likely R' THEN 5 
    WHEN 'Solid D' THEN 6 
    WHEN 'Solid R' THEN 7 
    ELSE 8 
  END, state_code, district
LIMIT 100;
